FCFS only -- no reservations on recreation.gov; pay on-site via Scan & Pay QR, ~$10/night. Seasonal, roughly mid-spring to fall (2025 open date May 22). Currently operating per 2025/26 USFS schedule. RV Life: 0* / $ (unrated). --Claude

name: Jake Best Campground
note: Primitive USFS campground on Citico Creek, Cherokee NF (Tellico Ranger District). 7 sites, standard nonelectric -- no hookups, no potable water (bring your own), vault toilet. Each site has picnic table, fire ring/grill, lantern post. Firsthand report: gravel road passable by normal vehicles (no 4WD), sites fairly level, Site 2 best for RVs. $6/site FCFS -- no advance reservations; pay on-site by cash/check or Recreation.gov Scan-and-Pay QR. Open roughly March-November (2025: Mar 6-Nov 17). Max 5 people / 2 vehicles per site; horses not allowed. RV Life: 0* / $ (unrated). --Claude

name: Look Rock Campground
note: GSMNP campground (reopened); 68 sites incl 10 with electric+water hookups (30/50-amp) -- the first Smokies campground to offer hookups -- plus dump station; remaining 58 sites no hookups. No showers. Reservation-required online only, no FCFS. Seasonal (~May-late Oct). Bear food-storage rules enforced. --Claude

name: Cosby Campground
note: GSMNP campground, 157 sites across loops A/B (138 tent-only, ~14 mixed tent/RV, 9 RV-only, 3 group); RV sites cap at 25 ft (some RV-only to 30 ft). No hookups; dump station; no showers or camp store. Reservation-only online (site-specific), no cash at office. Seasonal (~mid-Apr to end of Oct). --Claude

name: Moonhill Bridge Campground
note: Free TVA primitive/dispersed lakeside camping near Moonhill Bridge on Douglas Lake; roughly 6-15 sites on both sides of Chestnut Hill Rd, some by the gravel boat ramp. Gravel access, no hookups, no water/electric, fire rings only. FCFS, no reservations; 14-night max. Seasonal (reported open Mar-Oct). --Claude

name: Ragland Bottom Campground
note: USACE (Center Hill Lake, Nashville District). 57 sites: 40 water+electric RV sites on the LAKE/MIDDLE loops (max length 51-72 ft, fits a 23-ft rig) + 16 non-electric tent sites (HILL loop). Dump station, showers. Reservable online; season ~April-November; credit/debit only. --Claude

name: Paint Creek
note: Cherokee NF campground along Paint Creek; 20 sites (sites 13/14/16 tent-only -> 17 RV-capable), pads ~50x25 ft so a 23-ft rig fits. No hookups; vault toilets. FCFS scan-and-pay (not advance-reservable), $10/night. Narrow/steep access road -- fine for 23 ft, not big rigs. Season ~May 5-Oct 24. --Claude

name: Floating Mill Park Campground
note: USACE (Center Hill Lake, Nashville District). ~105 sites across two loops (TCLP, FMIP); most water+electric 30/50-amp RV sites (max length 16-48 ft; larger sites fit a 23-ft rig, some sub-23-ft sites do not), pull-throughs at 19-22/38-41/52, plus stair-access tent-only lakeshore sites. No sewer. Reservable online; season ~mid-April to early November. --Claude

name: Poole Knobs Campground
note: USACE (J. Percy Priest Lake, Nashville District). 78 sites (loop PKNO) + 1 group site: mix of water+electric, non-electric, and tent-only sites; gravel spurs 18-40 ft (larger sites fit a 23-ft rig). No sewer; dump station, flush toilets, showers. Reservable online; season ~May-September. --Claude

name: Long Branch Campground
note: USACE (Caney Fork River tailwater below Center Hill Dam, Nashville District). 60 sites: 52 water + 50-amp electric (loop LBRA) + 9-site group loop (GLOO); max length 45-75 ft, easily fits a 23-ft rig. Flush toilets, showers, laundry, dump station, boat ramp. Reservable online; season ~April-October; credit card only. --Claude

name: Anderson Road Campground
note: USACE (J. Percy Priest Lake, Nashville District); distinct from the adjacent Anderson Road day-use area. 37 sites: ~10 electric/RV sites (15/30/50-amp, max ~45 ft, fits a 23-ft rig) + ~26 primitive/tent sites (some non-electric driveways cap at 20 ft). No sewer; dump station, showers, laundry, boat ramp. Reservable online; short season ~mid-May to early September. --Claude

name: Seven Points Campground
note: USACE (J. Percy Priest Lake, Nashville District). 59-60 standard sites + 2 group shelters; all standard sites 50-amp electric + water, paved back-in pads, RVs to ~45 ft (select pull-throughs longer). No sewer; dump station, flush toilets, hot showers, laundry, boat ramp, swim beach. Reservable online; season ~April to late October. --Claude

name: Cedar Creek Campground (Old Hickory Lake)
note: USACE (Old Hickory Lake, Cumberland River, Nashville District) -- on Old Hickory Lake, not Percy Priest. ~60 sites in wooded wagon-wheel/cul-de-sac loops, one-way roads; water + electric 30/50-amp, RVs to ~41-43 ft (tight but fits a 23-ft rig). No sewer; laundry, hot showers, playground, adjacent boat launch. Reservable online; season ~mid-April to mid-October. --Claude

name: Cages Bend Campground
note: USACE Nashville District, Old Hickory Lake (Cumberland River). 43 sites, all with 50-amp electric + water hookups on gravel pads; site lengths well over 23 ft (~38-40 ft typical). Flush toilets, hot showers, laundry, dump station, boat ramp, two fishing docks. Reservation-only via recreation.gov (no walk-ins). Season ~April-October. --Claude

name: Lock A Campground
note: USACE Nashville District, Cheatham Lake (Cumberland River). 45 sites; ~38 RV/standard electric + 7 tent-only sites, all 50-amp electric (RV sites well over 23 ft). Modern restrooms, hot showers, dump station, boat launch, swimming area, playground. Reservation-only via recreation.gov (no walk-up sites). Season ~April-October. --Claude

name: Salt Lick Creek Campground
note: USACE Nashville District, Cordell Hull Lake (Cumberland River). 150 family sites + 1 group shelter, all with electric hookups; one wheeled unit per site. Flush toilets, showers, laundry, dump station, boat ramp, playground, visitor center. Sites organized in LAKE/WOOD/STRE/SLIC loops. Reservable via recreation.gov. Season ~April-October. --Claude

name: Obey River Park
note: USACE Nashville District, Dale Hollow Lake. 123 single + 4 group sites; mix of paved RV sites, gravel RV/tent sites, and tent-only sites. Most have electric, many with water; some 50-amp; no sewer. RV sites well over 23 ft. Swimming beach, boat launch, courtesy float, playgrounds. Reservable via recreation.gov; 14-day stay limit. Season ~mid-April to mid-October. --Claude

name: Bumpus Mills Campground
note: USACE Nashville District, Lake Barkley (Cumberland River section, Stewart County). Compact 15-site campground, all RV electric sites with water + electric (30-50 amp); no sewer; sites fit 23-ft+ rigs. Hot showers, dump station, boat ramp, nearby public marina. Seasonal: ~early May to early September. Reservable online via recreation.gov. --Claude

name: Notchy Creek Campground
note: Drive-in RV campground on a Tellico Lake peninsula near Vonore, operated by the Tellico Reservoir Development Agency (TRDA, an independent TN state agency on former TVA land). ~50 RV sites + a few primitive tent sites, gravel and fairly level; every RV site has electric (30/50-amp) + water, no sewer (dump station). 2 bathhouses, swim beach, store, boat ramp. Reservable online via Campspot, gated entry. Season ~mid-Mar to mid-Nov. --Claude

name: Poland Creek Campground & Recreation Area
note: City of Louisville campground on Fort Loudoun Lake (leased from TVA), bordered by Poland Creek. 24 electric sites (16 on the shoreline, 8 set back) + 8 tent sites, gravel pads, 50-amp available, boat launch, swimming area, playground. Season April-October. Reservable via the city; note that electric sites are often rented for the full season early in the year, limiting short-term electric availability. RV Life: 0* (unrated) / $. --Claude

name: Riley Creek Campground (Roane County)
note: Roane County Parks & Rec campground on Watts Bar Lake (TVA land, TVA Camp-Right gold-level). ~45 sites, water + electric hookups (mostly 30-amp, some 50-amp), 6 pull-through, accepts big rigs (~to 40 ft), boat launch, two swimming areas. Season April-October; first-come, first-served (no reservations). --Claude

name: Buchanan Resort
note: Kentucky Lake fishing/RV resort est. 1946, Springville; open mid-March–mid-Nov. Three campgrounds with gravel full/partial-hookup sites for RVs up to 40 ft; nightly/monthly/seasonal. 350-slip marina, restaurant, store, pool. RV Life 4★/$$, 3 reviews; nightly camping confirmed on operator site. --Claude

name: Cherokee Trails Campground and Stables
note: Small private campground at base of Holston Mountain on Morrell Creek, adjacent to Cherokee NF (offers equestrian sites but is a general drive-in campground). ~22 gravel full-hookup sites (30A, W, S), open Mar-Nov, cash/check only. Access roads narrow/tight; a 30-ft trailer reportedly fit but no pull-throughs for big rigs. Reserve by phone. --Claude

name: Crazy Horse Recreational Park
note: The original Buffalo River outfitter, family-run for 35 years at Bell Bridge on Hwy 13 just north of Waynesboro. Its North and South campgrounds have 30/50-amp electric-and-water RV sites along over a mile of river frontage (a few septic sites for monthly stays), free showers and restrooms, a camp store, and canoe and kayak floats. Open April to October. First come, first served with no reservations; cash only, paid at the gate or to a camping assistant; the gates are never locked; no generators. Office and South Campground at 2505 Waynesboro Hwy, North Campground at 2501. --Claude

name: DeKalb County Public Lake
note: DeKalb County public fishing lake near Sylvania; 10 campsites, 4 set up for RVs with water/electric, public restrooms, boat launch. Open sunrise-sunset (closed Wednesdays; closed late Nov-Feb). RV Life unrated. --Claude

name: Starkey (Beaver Lake)
note: USACE Beaver Lake campground; 24 sites (7 water+electric, 16 electric), boat ramp, seasonal (~May to mid-Sep). Reservable online. --Claude

name: Dam Site River (Beaver Dam tailwater)
note: USACE campground below Beaver Dam on the White River cold-water tailwater (trout fishing); 59 standard-electric sites, water/electric, dump, showers, boat ramp, RVs up to ~78 ft. Reservable online; seasonal Apr-Oct. --Claude

name: Cossatot Reefs (Gillham Lake)
note: USACE campground on Gillham Lake (Cossatot River project), open early March to late November. Reservable sites with electric. Reservable online. --Claude

name: Little Fir (Lake Ouachita)
note: USACE (Vicksburg District) campground on the western shore of Lake Ouachita off Hwy 188 near Mount Ida. 29 sites, all with water and 50-amp electric (no sewer); boat ramp. Max RV/trailer 35 ft (fits a 23-ft rig). Reservable online; seasonal (roughly May-Oct). --Claude

name: Cherokee Park (Arkansas River)
note: USACE (Little Rock District) campground on the Arkansas River (Lake Dardanelle / Rockefeller Lake pool) near Morrilton. About 33 Class A sites with 30/50A electric and water; hot showers, dock, boat ramp, dump station, two group shelters. Reservable online; seasonal (roughly Mar-Oct). --Claude

name: Piney Bay (Lake Dardanelle)
note: USACE (Little Rock District) campground on the Piney Bay arm of Lake Dardanelle near London. About 68 sites with electric; hot showers, two boat ramps, swim beach. Reservable online; seasonal (roughly Mar-Oct). --Claude

name: Horsehead Lake Recreation Area
note: Ozark-St. Francis National Forest (Pleasant Hill Ranger District) campground on the 100-acre Horsehead Lake. 10 sites, FCFS (no reservations), accommodating camping trailers/RVs up to 30 ft; no hookups, hot-shower bathhouse, drinking water, playground, no-wake lake with boating/fishing/swimming. Paved access via FR 1408. Open seasonally ~Mar 1-Nov 1; $15/night. RV Life unrated. --Claude
